Maria (Design): Quick copy + accessibility pass on the org switch control. I sketched tooltip text and an empty state. Can folks check tone, clarity, and keyboard/a11y stuff? Maria (Design): Current tooltip draft: `Switch organizations to view data for different accounts.` Empty state draft: `You don't have any organizations yet. Create one to get started.` Maria (Design): Concerns: inconsistency between 'organization' and 'workspace', tooltip length on small screens, and discoverability for keyboard users. Kevin (PM): We should stick with 'organization' (used in billing/RBAC). Tooltip should be shorter and more action-oriented 94 e.g., 'switch your active org' vs 'view data'. Sam (Frontend): Agree on shortening. Tooltips wrap weirdly on mobile. Suggest `Switch active organization` (compact). Also: add role="tooltip" and ensure it appears on focus, not just hover. Alex (Eng): Accessibility notes: Make the control a focusable button with aria-haspopup="listbox" and toggle aria-expanded. Don't rely solely on tooltip to explain the action 94 mirror the brief hint in the opened menu header. Also avoid trailing punctuation in tooltip copy so screen readers read it succinctly. Kevin (PM): For empty state, propose: Heading: `No organizations yet` Body: `Create an organization to get started.` CTA: `Create organization` (verb-first to match other CTAs). Sam (Frontend): Small reading note: contractions like "Don't" can sound odd with some screen readers. Use `No organizations yet`. Maria (Design): New agreed copy: Tooltip: `Switch active organization` (no period). Empty state heading: `No organizations yet` Body: `Create an organization to get started.` Button: `Create organization` Maria (Design): Hand-off snippet for dev: ```html
Switch active organization
``` Alex (Eng): Two dev follow-ups: 1) Ensure tooltip appears on keyboard focus as well as hover. 2) On narrow screens hide the tooltip until focus/press and make sure the trigger label stays visible. a11y-bot: Auto-check results: tooltip text/background contrast fails (ratio 1.3:1 for #ffffff on #f2f2f2). Recommend dark text (#111827) or darker background. Also recommend setting aria-describedby on the trigger to reference the tooltip id for proper narration. Kevin (PM): Good catch. Maria, add ARIA note and acceptance criteria: tooltip must be announced by screen readers, visible on focus and hover, and meet WCAG contrast >= 4.5:1. Focus ring per DS is required. Maria (Design): Updated handoff bundle: Tooltip copy: `Switch active organization` Handoff notes: set trigger aria-describedby="org-switch-tooltip"; ensure tooltip role="tooltip"; tooltip visible on hover and focus; meets WCAG contrast >= 4.5:1. Empty state: Heading: `No organizations yet` Body: `Create an organization to get started.` CTA: `Create organization` Sam (Frontend): I'll add aria-describedby and pad the focus outline in CSS. Will run contrast checks and report back. Alex (Eng): I'll add the acceptance criteria to the ticket. Marking ready-for-dev once contrast is validated in the component. :thumbsup: Maria (Design): Thanks all 94 I'll attach the a11y checklist to the PR and update the pattern doc. :sparkles:
